description: Phase C3.7: the orchestrator and its extracted ingestion-pipeline service must contain ZERO hard-coded `provider === '<key>'` control-flow branches. Provider-specific work runs through the post-ingest hook registry (`src/modules/integrations/orchestrator/canonical-ingestion-hooks.js`); each provider self-registers via the bootstrap entry point. Adding a new branch in either of the scanned files requires writing a hook in the provider module instead and is rejected by the gate.

rules.newBranchesNotAllowed: Adding a new `if (provider === '<key>')` branch in any scanned file requires (a) writing a post-ingest hook in the adapter module and registering it via `canonicalIngestionHooks.registerAfterEntities` / `registerAfterLive` and (b) explicit justification in the PR description. Drive-by additions fail the governance gate. The baseline is empty as of C3.7 because the orchestrator no longer needs to know about any provider key.
